text: This report requests City Council's authority to amend Solid Waste Management Services' approved 2018 Capital Budget and 2019-2027 Capital Plan by adjusting project costs and cash flows in order to realign funding with the amount of committed cash flows required to deliver projects. The adjustments will have a net-zero impact on both the 2018 Capital Budget and the 2019-2027 Capital Plan and will commit already approved Capital Plan estimates. These adjustments will be funded through the Perpetual Care Reserve Fund. In addition, this report recommends an adjustment to the cash flow carry forwards from 2017 to 2018 based on actual year-end spending.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the reallocation of project costs in the amount of $5.037 million from the 2019 estimated Capital Plan to the 2018 Capital Budget to be funded from Solid Waste Management Services Perpetual Care Reserve (XR1013) with cash flow commitments as presented in Attachment 1 to the report (March 29, 2018) from the General Manager, Solid Waste Management Services. 2. City Council authorize a reduction to Solid Waste Management Services approved carry forward cash flows from 2017 to 2018 in the amount of $3.213 million as detailed in Attachment 2 to the report (March 29, 2018) from the General Manager, Solid Waste Management Services.
